title: Efficient Compression of Multitask Multilingual Speech Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Word Error Rate (WER) differences between male and female speakers using the Balanced-FLEURS and Common Voice 13 datasets before and after model quantization.
Analyzing Word Error Rate (WER) performance degradation after model quantization across different speaker age groups in the Common Voice 13 dataset.

Evaluating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance and the disproportionate impact of model quantization across different languages categorized by their resourcefulness (amount of available training data).
Assessing how post-training quantization disproportionately degrades the performance of smaller model architectures compared to larger ones.
